bio: Italy is the guest of honour courtesy of an enthusiastic and talented chef who crafts a creative Italian score made from quality ingredients showcased in tasting menus, including one vegetarian. From vitello tonnato and scialatielli with tellina clams to crispy courgette flowers, each generous, skilfully executed dish is packed with flavour and a hint of Mediterranean delicacy. The chef's husband supervises the warm, seamless service, ensuring that this gourmet experience embodies both authenticity and good food in a welcoming ambience.
